description: v1 closes the unrepresentable per-leg moderator mute branch while preserving ordinary call and self-mute paths.

cases.name: mute_override_alone_is_rejected
cases.given: a signed ak.call.state Event contains only call_id and mute_override
cases.action: validate the kind-bound payload and submit it
cases.observed: Event, Commit and typed current writes
assertions: no Event or Commit is accepted and no call_mute_override result is written

cases.name: mute_override_cannot_hide_in_another_delta
cases.given: a signed ak.call.state Event carries a valid roster_delta and mute_override together
cases.action: validate and submit the complete Event
assertions: the whole Event is rejected with zero roster and mute writes

cases.name: moderator_mute_signal_does_not_control_media
cases.given: an encrypted ak.call.signal mute_state frame decrypts to by=moderator and names a target leg
cases.action: deliver it to an authorized receiving endpoint and request media permission
cases.observed: client handling and token issuer or SFU permission
assertions: the frame cannot create a mute override or authorize a forced-mute permission
an old per-leg cache or call-only result cannot be treated as an unmute decision

cases.name: self_mute_and_other_moderation_remain_open
cases.given: an otherwise valid by=self mute_state and separately authorized kick, ban and end-for-all operations
cases.action: apply their existing independent admission rules
cases.observed: self media UX and the registered call moderation or state paths
assertions: self mute creates no call_mute_override result
disabling force mute does not disable the other registered call paths
